item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .drydock-probe && cat > .drydock-probe/probe.sh <<'EOF'
#"'!/bin/sh
set -eu
root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
tmp="$root/.drydock-probe/tree"
mkdir -p "$tmp/sub"
printf alpha > "$tmp/a"
printf alpha > "$tmp/sub/b"
printf beta > "$tmp/c"
: > "$tmp/empty1"
: > "$tmp/empty2"
ln -s a "$tmp/link"
ln -s / "$tmp/sub/dirlink"
"$root/dupfind" "$tmp" > "$root/.drydock-probe/list.csv"
"$root/dupfind" --summary "$tmp" > "$root/.drydock-probe/summary.csv"
"$root/dupfind" "$tmp/missing" > "$root/.drydock-probe/error.out" 2>/dev/null && exit 10 || rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 1 ] && [ ! -s "$root/.drydock-probe/error.out" ] || exit 11
cat "$root/.drydock-probe/list.csv"
cat "$root/.drydock-probe/summary.csv"
EOF
chmod +x .drydock-probe/probe.sh
go build -o dupfind ./cmd/dupfind && .drydock-probe/probe.sh
'
